name: ET Southeast Bossier Pipeline Phase 1
researcher_notes: Energy Transfer built this 165-mile line in East Texas. It was placed in service on April 28, 2008. The EIA natural gas pipeline projects table for August 2026, sheet Historical Projects, Excel row 506, lists ET Southeast Boosier (sic) Pipeline Phase 1 by Energy Transfer Co: new pipeline, completed, 165 miles, 24 and 42 inch, 900 MMcf/d, cost 360 million dollars, intrastate in Texas, state authority. The file spells the name Boosier. The URL verifier confirmed the name with that spelling. No existing GEM row matches. The only Energy Transfer row near it is the Texas Intrastate System aggregate, which is a different record. The 165 miles is well above the 15.5 mile minimum. Phase 2 (70 miles, 24 inch, 400 MMcf/d, EIA row 540) is a separate possible row not vetted here. Endpoints were not entered. An NGI article from 2008 and an oil and gas trade journal article report Farrar to Silsbee, Texas and a connection to the Houston Pipe Line system, but those pages did not pass the verifier name or value check, so they are not cited. Only one source is cited, so the tier is high with no second independent source. The route was not found. Intrastate lines do not appear in FERC filings, so a state regulator filing could be checked next.
